claim().notice: Pull accrued fees from the escrow. Half goes to the owner wallet at once,         half stays for the next feeding. Anyone may call.

claimBasket(address).notice: Waking: claim your share of one basket token. Per token, so one broken token         cannot block the others. Can be called again whenever more of that token arrives.

claimable(address,address).notice: View: what `user` could claim of `token` right now (0 before waking).

release().notice: Feeding: send the whole ETH balance (minus any deferred owner half) to the operator,         who buys the top 3.

withdrawOwner().notice: Retry a deferred owner payment. Anyone may call.
